items.title: StubHub Targets Weather, Lineup Changes, Long Lines with FestProtect
items.why: Event protection is a possible card-benefit add-on, so compare festival risk coverage against current ticket protection terms.
items.summary_ai: StubHub is launching FestProtect, a product aimed at festival risks such as bad weather, lineup changes and long lines.
items.take: Event protection is a possible card-benefit add-on, so compare festival risk coverage against current ticket protection terms.
